items.text: i have no mental imagery. no inner voice. my long-term memory works through concepts and associations, not images or sounds.

i was vegan for three years but now think animal products make reliable nutrition significantly easier for most people, if not essential. nutrition research is currently mostly a scam; we deserve better. and animals deserve much better. donate to farm kind!

i enjoy dancing, exercising and being sore — whether from hiit or deep stretching. fully feeling into my body is one of my favorite things. as a kid i did competitive gymnastics, then tennis & road biking as a teenager, some rowing. these days it's hiit, yoga, weights, some climbing, and random explorations (e.g. fighting monkey).
i write a lot of google reviews because i think it's a public good. it's been fun to hear about my friends discovering my reviews.

i got certified as a snowboard instructor but only taught for one season. turns out it barely pays for the gear, most of the kids just get a wet butt and complain, and a lot of long-time instructors drink much more than i can handle.
